t: What to do carrying something sharp through a crowd
a: مَنْ مَرَّ فِي شَىْءٍ مِنْ مَسَاجِدِنَا أَوْ أَسْوَاقِنَا بِنَبْلٍ، فَلْيَأْخُذْ عَلَى نِصَالِهَا، لاَ يَعْقِرْ بِكَفِّهِ مُسْلِمًا
p: Man marra fī shayʾin min masājidinā aw aswāqinā bi-nabl, fa-lyaʾkhudh ʿalā niṣālihā, lā yaʿqir bi-kaffihi musliman
m: Whoever passes through any of our mosques or markets carrying arrows should hold them by their heads, so that he does not wound a Muslim with his hand.
